# Writer-to-BigQuery interoperability, verified by maintainer-recorded BigQuery
# answers in tools/kll/writer.answers.txt. Source inputs were INT64/FLOAT64 1..66,
# precision 1; the compactors retained odd values at level 1, and 65/66 at level 0.
# Do not compare INIT output bytes: compaction is randomized.
# Specification: third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/kll_functions.md.

SELECT STRUCT(KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64(ANY_VALUE(s), 4) AS extracted, KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_INT64(s, 4) AS merged, KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_INT64(KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s), 4) AS partial) FROM UNNEST([FROM_HEX('0871104220048a0734084010011a01012201422a04120241012a2212200102020202020202020202020202020202020202020202020202020202020202')]) AS s
=> {"f":[{"v":[{"v":"1"},{"v":"17"},{"v":"33"},{"v":"49"},{"v":"66"}]},{"v":[{"v":"1"},{"v":"17"},{"v":"33"},{"v":"49"},{"v":"66"}]},{"v":[{"v":"1"},{"v":"17"},{"v":"33"},{"v":"49"},{"v":"66"}]}]}

SELECT STRUCT(KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_FLOAT64(ANY_VALUE(s), 4) AS extracted, KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_FLOAT64(s, 4) AS merged, KLL_QUANTILES.EXTRACT_FLOAT64(KLL_QUANTILES.MERGE_PARTIAL(s), 4) AS partial) FROM UNNEST([FROM_HEX('')]) AS s
=> {"f":[{"v":[{"v":"1.0"},{"v":"17.0"},{"v":"33.0"},{"v":"49.0"},{"v":"66.0"}]},{"v":[{"v":"1.0"},{"v":"17.0"},{"v":"33.0"},{"v":"49.0"},{"v":"66.0"}]},{"v":[{"v":"1.0"},{"v":"17.0"},{"v":"33.0"},{"v":"49.0"},{"v":"66.0"}]}]}
